articles.description: British counterterrorism police have arrested five men near RAF Fairford on suspicion of preparing a terrorist act after three suspicious vans were reported heading toward the strategically important base used by U.S. forces. Donald Trump said the suspects were planning to cause “big damage” and praised the joint U.S.-UK operation that led to the arrests.Investigators are examining several possible motives. Reuters reports that an Iran-linked motive is currently considered the most likely by a source familiar with the probe, while a possible Russian sabotage operation and an Islamist plot are also being investigated.
